newsitem.title: UK: S&P gives SAI AA minus claims rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives SAI AA minus claims rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it assigned its AA minus claims-paying ability rating to SAI SpA of Italy.

"The rating reflects the company's leading position in the Italian motor market, excellent operating performance, strong management, together with efficient multi-distribution channels, good capitalisation and sound reserving," an S&P statement said.
But partly offsetting these strengths, S&P said the company is exposed to the fortunes of the domestic motor market and has a restricted financial flexibility.

"SAI's business position appears secure in the short and medium term. In the longer term, however, SAI may have to adapt further to new forms of distribution and its success in life business will ultimately depend on its ability to strengthen its bancassurance channels and penetrate the pensions market."
-- its excellent business position In non-life. SAI is the main operating entity of the SAI Group, Italy's third largest insurance non-life group behind Generali and RAS,
-- strong Management, which has shown a pro-active strategy in order to maintain its business position, both in life and non-life insurance,

-- strong operating results despite the fact that over 55 percent of SAI's non-life premium income is derived from domestic motor third party liability, a traditionally unprofitable business in Italy,
-- an improved non-life underwriting result with a loss ratio of 83.8 percent in 1995 vs 93.5 percent at the beginning of the decade,
-- a successful active trading investment philosophy, and
-- the profitable contribution from life activities, particularly through SAI's bancassurance affiliates and subsidiaries.
S&P said it expects SAI to post good results in 1996 and to maintain its leading position in the domestic motor market into the medium term.
